summary: Phase 149O.20E -- HMIC v1.2 HBDC Bound-Contract Identity Independent Verification: INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ONLY. Initial inspection confirmed repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.20D.1 completed/complete/pushed, pcae health/check/status-coherence/push-check/runtime-inspect/notify-status all as expected. Read docs/contracts/HATP_MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT.md (Sections 0, 17-20, 39-41, 49-52) and docs/contracts/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md (all 30 sections) directly, plus production source (hatp_mandatory_certification.py, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py). Independently reconstructed the v1.1 baseline (24 files, four-member contract_versions) and 149O.20D's diff (contract_versions 4 to 5, requirements 144 to 145, attacks 34 to 36) from the frozen 5671448a git snapshot -- confirmed to be the exact pre-repair 149O.20D commit the governing instruction names. Independently reproduced finding B-149O.20D-1 fresh from that snapshot: confirmed all four premises (HBDC-001 was a contract_versions member; its binding was version-header comparison only; its document was absent from the 24-file implementation_scope_digest enumeration; a modeled same-version content mutation was invisible to both mechanisms) via fresh regex extraction and git show, never accepted from 149O.20D.1's own prose. Independently re-walked HMIC-REQ-050/053 to reconstruct the existing four bound contracts' dual-binding mechanism (version semantics via contract_versions plus content semantics via implementation_scope_digest, two independent identity dimensions) before evaluating whether the repaired HBDC-001 now conforms to it -- confirmed it does. Independently reconstructed 149O.20D.1's repair diff (HMIC-REQ-050 24 to 25 files, the sole addition being docs/contracts/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md; HMIC-REQ-145 CLOSED; attack matrix 36 to 37; CIVC count unchanged at 12). Freshly extracted the live contract's inventories via independent regex parsing, not copied from any prior test module: 145 gapless requirements, 12 CIVCs, 37 sequential attack rows, exactly 25 HMIC-REQ-050 files, exactly 5 contract_versions members -- the only deltas from history being the disclosed +1/+1 (HBDC-001's document / HBDC-001 contract ID). Implemented HMIC-REQ-054-058's digest algorithm from scratch in this phase's own test module, deliberately never calling production's derive_implementation_scope_digest: run against a scratch copy of the live 25-file set (never the real working tree), confirmed a same-version, content-only HBDC-001 mutation changes the digest (the principal repair criterion); confirmed the same mutation-sensitivity individually for each of the four pre-existing bound contracts (unweakened, not regressed by HBDC-001's addition); confirmed all 25 files are individually digest-sensitive (25 of 25); confirmed a missing HBDC-001 scratch file fails closed (raises rather than silently omitting); exercised production's own real _resolve_and_reject_unsafe_frozen_file primitive directly to confirm a symlinked HBDC-001 position is rejected, with no HBDC-specific relaxation of the pre-existing symlink/non-regular-file safety discipline. Confirmed version-drift (contract_versions/HMIC-REQ-069, CONTRACT_MISMATCH) and Contract-ID-drift (closed-schema MALFORMED, attack #36's reasoning) detection remain textually intact and unaffected by this repair. Confirmed HMIC-REQ-063's live text is byte-identical to the frozen 5671448a snapshot via direct diff -- not solved by this repair; HBDC-001's own Option-C boundary (HBDC-REQ-040/041) remains conditional on the separately-verified Model-A environment lock, no unconditional acceptance; Models B/C/D remain unauthorized. Confirmed production's _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES remains 24 (no Class-B contract path present) and _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES remains the pre-20D four-member set (no HBDC-001 entry), both unmodified since 149O.20D.1; confirmed the Wave-F validator caller in hatp_mandatory_cutover.py (validate_active_hatp_mandatory_independent_verification_certification, gated through certification_status_satisfies_readiness) is present and unmodified -- not the zero-caller state some earlier phase prose once assumed. Confirmed no real certification storage exists at HATPTrustStore's production-resolved root on this host via direct filesystem inspection. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20E_HMIC_V1_2_HBDC_BOUND_CONTRACT_IDENTITY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md and one new, independent test module, tests/test_phase_149o_20e_hmic_v1_2_hbdc_bound_contract_identity_independent_verification.py (55 tests, all passed), which does not import or reuse 149O.20D.1's own expected-value constants as an oracle. Ran the 20A-20D.1 regression suites together (189 passed, 2 skipped, 1 pre-existing failure -- 20C's own fixed-version self-check broken by 149O.20D's intervening v1.1 to v1.2 bump, confirmed pre-existing via git stash). Ran the broad HMIC/HBDC sweep (pytest -k 'hmic or hbdc or 149o_20 or 149o_19_5', excluding the pre-existing fido2-import collection error): 37 failed, 818 passed, 4 skipped -- confirmed via git stash that all 37 are identical pre-existing repin-debt, unaffected by this phase's own new, isolated, fully-passing test file. Ran Fast Green (same exclusion): 62 failed, 6459 passed, 4 skipped -- the 37 above are a subset; the remaining approximately 25 are unrelated pre-existing failures in older phase test modules (a stale interpreter-version pin, older HATP-consumption caller-count assertions), none newly caused by this phase since it introduced zero shared-import surface capable of affecting unrelated modules. Zero src/pcae/**, zero scripts/**, zero contract files changed -- HMIC-001 and HBDC-001 confirmed byte-unchanged in the working tree throughout via git status --porcelain. No Blocking findings; no new Non-Blocking findings (HMIC-REQ-053's pre-existing, already-disclosed placement of contract bytes inside implementation_scope_digest is not a defect this phase introduces or newly exposes). Verdict: HMIC-001 v1.2 -- INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- HBDC BOUND-CONTRACT CONTENT IDENTITY CONFORMS. B-149O.20D-1: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED AT CONTRACT LEVEL -- production alignment pending. HBDC-BINDING-GATE: CONTRACT CONTENT-BINDING INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- production 25-file/5-contract alignment pending -- NOT CLOSED. Class-B: CONTRACT VERIFIED -- NOT PROVISIONED (unchanged). HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. This phase does not authorize provisioning, certification, activation, or production alignment. Recommended next phase: 149O.20F -- HMIC v1.2 HBDC 25-File / 5-Contract Production Identity Alignment, a bounded scope updating only the two production constants, no semantic change, no provisioning.
